answer: Locks are recorded in jade, expire in anchor, and wharf lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 112 aliases therefore needs 188 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1683 identities would post 2535 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
